units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 46a">Ab. Zar. 46ᵃ</cite> a byname <he>לג׳</he> of reproach, (cacophemistic, opp. <he>לשבח</he>).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 33b">Kidd. 33ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:2:6">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חד אמר לג׳</he> one says ‘they looked after Moses’ (<cite ref="Exodus 33:8">Ex. XXXIII, 8</cite>) with the purpose of fault-finding; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27.

<cite ref="Megillah 25b:16">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המקראות … לג׳ וכ׳</he> words in the Torah which, as they are written (v. <cite ref="K01357"><he>כתיב</he></cite>), have become obscene, are in reading changed &c. (<cite ref="U00229"><he>שגל</he></cite> changed into <he>שכב</he> &c.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 33b:22">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ הוא לו</he> it would be offering an insult to him; a. fr.
